name: needy
description: Needy — a realtime help-matching platform where every signal is evidence of a real, present human.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend,landing -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:landing"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run build:shared && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
